# Delivery operations instructions

## Focus

- roadmap
- ADRs
- release notes
- agent handovers
- execution clarity

## Rules

- Keep docs concise and current
- Record why a decision changed, not only what changed
- Link milestones to actual implementation work
- Surface blockers clearly
- Do not let status artifacts drift from repo reality

## Done means

- docs reflect the latest approved direction
- milestone state is clear
- blockers and approvals are visible
